description: This file contains pytest-based functional tests for device IP configurations and related device information, utilizing rbus data access functions to verify configuration parameters.

methods.name: test_DeviceDefault_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests retrieving various device information properties like SoftwareVersion, ModelName, FirmwareFilename, and setting RFC feature enablement.

methods.name: test_DeviceIP_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests getting and verifying IPv6 and IPv4 interface configuration parameters such as addresses, prefix, origin, enable status, and lifetimes.

methods.name: test_DeviceServices_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Verifies the number of device services entries, ensuring correct configuration data.

methods.name: test_ReverseSSH_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests the reverse SSH status, trigger, and arguments configuration properties.
